research.title: How do principles shape perceived relevance?
research.copy: Survey responses → normalized data → principle vectors → case relevance. The relationship is still under investigation.
research.note: Research first. Ask people next. Leave room for the answer to stay complicated.

margin.title: Sounding certain is not the same as understanding.
margin.copy: A reminder written sideways beside the analysis: uncertainty can be an honest result, not an unfinished performance.

diagram.title: A diagram made before the clean version.
diagram.copy: Question, observation, model, test, correction. The arrows loop backward because the first answer is rarely the last useful one.
diagram.note: Ask what the model leaves out.
